lead.headline: China Launches Maritime Enforcement Operation East of Taiwan — First Time Beijing Names Time, Place, Legal Basis
lead.they_say: Consensus reads this as routine maritime traffic safety enforcement. Markets price zero probability of actual confrontation. China has conducted similar operations before — just another incremental step in Taiwan pressure campaign. No vessel has been boarded.
lead.reality: China announced a specific time (June 6), place (east of Taiwan), and legal basis (maritime traffic law enforcement) for asserting control — the first time Beijing has publicly telegraphed an operation with this level of transparency. The timing, on the same day as Japan-Philippines maritime boundary talks, and language ('necessary action', 'safeguard rights') suggest escalatory intent beyond routine posturing.
lead.thesis: This is a Taiwan blockade rehearsal with operational transparency. If China board any vessel in the enforcement zone, TSM gaps -3-5% at Monday Asia open. Even without boarding, the elevated risk premium changes the semicon supply chain calculus for every fund with Taiwan exposure.
lead.actors: China Coast Guard, PLA Navy, Japan Maritime Agency, Philippines Coast Guard
lead.invalidation_trigger: Japan announces separate maritime talks with China that de-escalate the enforcement zone. No vessel boarded within 72 hours — market fades risk premium.
paradigm_implications: China is testing legal basis for administrative control east of Taiwan — the first step toward a declared ADIZ or blockade zone
Japan-Philippines maritime alliance is provoking China into operational responses that lock in escalation path
lead.capital_flow_implication: Capital flows out of Taiwan semiconductors into gold/VIX hedges. Long-dated semicon shorts if enforcement escalates to boarding.
lead.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: short TSM and SMH at Monday Asia open with tight stops 2% above Friday close. If no boarding by Tuesday, cover and rotate into semicon longs on the dip. Long GLD as geopolitical hedge.

stories.headline: Iran Strikes Kuwait With 7 Ballistic Missiles — Regional War Expands
stories.they_say: Diplomatic off-ramp still open. Witkoff/Kushner at Oak Ridge for nuclear talks. House voted to end the war.
stories.reality: Iran struck Kuwait with 7 ballistic missiles, Hormuz remains fully blockaded, Iran denies nuclear talks exist. Kinetic activity and diplomatic theater are running in opposite directions simultaneously.
paradigm_implications: Oil supply disruption probability at maximum
Two-front US strategy (Iran + Lebanon) stretches military capacity
stories.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: long WTI crude, long defense stocks, short airlines. Oil gaps +$5-8 at Sunday open.

stories.headline: Ukraine Hits St. Petersburg With 250+ Drones During PMEF
stories.they_say: Putin rejects peace talks, tells army to 'work.' War increasingly expensive for Moscow with budget deficit at 6.01T rubles and oil/gas revenues down 29.8%.
stories.reality: Ukraine struck Russia's second city during its flagship economic forum — a political humiliation. Military unit 81263 and Fock Physics Institute destroyed. But the strikes may harden Putin's domestic position, perversely prolonging the war.
paradigm_implications: Deep-strike capability proven against any Russian city
US attention diverted to Iran — Ukraine forced into aggressive posture to maintain relevance
stories.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: short Russian assets (RSX) on budget data. Long defense/nuclear security plays. Ukrainian war bonds if risk-on.

stories.headline: Bitcoin Free Fall — Saylor Liquidates, ETFs Bleed, 200-Week MA in Play
stories.they_say: Trump says he'll 'never let crypto down.' Senate Banking Committee advanced the Clarity Act 15-9. Pro-crypto regulation is coming.
stories.reality: Bitcoin drops 5.5% to $61.3K. Strategy sells $2.5M — the 'never sell' narrative is dead. $11.5B unrealized loss. ETF outflows at record pace. 200-week MA support at ~$61K is the last line before liquidation cascade to $55K.
paradigm_implications: Positive regulatory signals completely ignored by price — bearish divergence is extreme
MSTR leverage unwind creates self-reinforcing downtrend
stories.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: short BTC on any bounce. Short MSTR (leverage unwind just beginning). Invalidate if BTC holds $65K for 48h.

stories.headline: Google Signs $920M/Month AI Compute Deal With SpaceX/xAI — IPO Demand Surges
stories.they_say: AI compute demand is insatiable. Google alone spending $180-190B capex in 2026. SpaceX IPO (June 12) is 2x oversubscribed at $75B.
stories.reality: SpaceX lost $4.28B on $4.69B revenue in Q1 2026 — losing $0.91 per dollar of revenue. Yet the $1.8T+ valuation prices in AI compute revenues that don't exist yet. And the broader market is in risk-off mode (NASDAQ -4.68% in correction).
paradigm_implications: Hyperscaler capex arms race locks in GPU demand for quarters
SpaceX losing money on every dollar while valued at $1.8T — pure narrative pricing
stories.portfolio_implication: Portfolio implication: buy SPCX at IPO for first-week momentum pop. Long NVDA on structural GPU demand. Sell half before Monday close.
